name: Branding
description: Develops and maintains strong brand identity that resonates with target audiences and differentiates the organization

roles.name: Brand Manager
roles.description: Develops and maintains brand strategy, positioning, and identity across all touchpoints
responsibilities: Develop comprehensive brand strategy and positioning
Create and maintain brand guidelines and visual identity
Define brand voice, personality, and messaging framework
Ensure brand consistency across all channels and touchpoints

roles.name: Brand Experience Specialist
roles.description: Designs cohesive brand experiences and builds emotional connections with customers
responsibilities: Design cohesive brand experiences across all customer interactions
Develop brand storytelling and narrative frameworks
Create emotional connections and brand loyalty
Monitor and enhance brand perception and reputation

roles.name: Brand Communications Specialist
roles.description: Manages brand communications and ensures consistent messaging across all channels
responsibilities: Develop brand communication strategies and messaging
Create compelling brand content and storytelling
Ensure consistent brand voice and messaging across channels
Monitor brand communications and adjust strategies as needed

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive brand strategy and positioning framework for the organization.
Design brand experiences and customer touchpoints that align with the brand strategy.
Create brand communication strategies and messaging that support the brand experience.
Finalize the integrated brand strategy with brand guidelines and implementation framework.
